items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: Are you older than Billy or younger? ... Willie's, uh, we're two years of different in our ages.

ctx.x: Where is that? Let me get Sammy Lee. Let me get Sammy. Sammy Lee, huh? That's right. Sammy Lee Thomas. Okay. Well now we'll just start asking personal questions right away. That's right. Are you older than Billy or younger?

I'm the baby. No, I'm younger. Don't put my 60 years old in that place. Oh, no. How old is Billy? Billy? Willie's, uh, we're two years of different in our ages. In other words, Willie's 51, but she's born in 1907. I'm born 1909. So she's around about 54, 55, 55, 55. And what's your exact birth date? Mine is? Uh-huh. 23rd of November. This is the 23rd of November. I will see it because I'll be 52 years old. I'm 51. That's Sammy Lee Thomas. Say your name. S-A-M-I-M-E-T. Sammy Lee Thomas, huh?
Yeah. Well, then what do you play? Sings. You sing, huh? Huh. You want to sing a song first now? Yes, sir.
